# DEVIATIONS — Spec Deviation Log

When the implementation must intentionally differ from a spec, record it here in the same
commit. Each deviation is its own file in [deviations/](deviations/).

## Template

```markdown
# D<nnn> — <title>

- **Date / milestone:** 2026-11-?? · M0?
- **Spec:** SPEC-0? §?
- **Status:** Open | Resolved → spec updated

> **DEVIATION:** see [D<nnn>](../deviations/D<nnn>-….md) — one-line summary
```

An inline example: `> **DEVIATION:** see [D001](deviations/D001-x.md)` must not be parsed.
